studies.title: The dodo
studies.caption: The dodo was a flightless bird of Mauritius, with small wings and a heavy curved bill. Its loss became one of the best-known stories of human-caused extinction.
studies.prompt: Reconstructed Raphus cucullatus in Mauritian coastal forest, full side view, sturdy but not obese grey-brown body, tiny real wings, tuft of pale curled tail feathers, strong yellow-grey legs, large hooked two-tone bill. Natural alert bird on fallen leaves, not comic fat caricature or turkey, no humans.
